reviews.text: I had such a wonderful facial experience! The treatment was incredibly relaxing. The therapist was professional, gentle and attentive throughout the treatment. I loved the whole experience and will definitely be coming back. Highly recommend! ✨
It’s a comfortable and relaxing experience! You can definitely the difference after one session. Teresa is so lovely, warm and welcoming.
This was amazing! An exceptionally wonderful experience! My whole face felt lifted after the treatment. Teresa's technique is superb, and it was incredibly comfortable and relaxing. 💗

I’ve been seeing Teresa for treatments and couldn’t recommend her more highly. She is professional, attentive and genuinely cares about her clients. Teresa always takes the time to understand what I’m looking for and makes me feel completely comfortable and relaxed throughout the treatment.

Her attention to detail is fantastic, and I’m always so happy with the results. She is also such a lovely person, which makes every appointment something I look forward to.

Highly recommend Teresa if you’re looking for a skilled, caring and professional therapist! ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
